rationale: Static legal-framework section of smlouvy.gov.cz; covered by monitoring the register itself but valuable for bounding coverage.
Act 340/2015 text with EN translation - a one-off reference document, not a recurring signal producer.
Metadata/form schema sub-page of the register; needed to design parsers, not monitored separately.
FAQ on the test instance testrs.gov.cz; operational detail only, and test-instance stability is unclear.
Service-catalogue description of the register on portal.gov.cz; adds procedure info, no independent stream.
Individual signed banking-contract PDFs are the core evidence layer (pricing, annexes, redactions) reached via the register.
zIndex methodology wiki is useful background for weighting buyer transparency but produces few in-scope signals.
Single small municipality's contract page; one of thousands, low yield unless a targeted gap-fill is needed.
One-off legal commentary article clarifying the banking-secrecy exemption; cite once, do not monitor.
ARES is the authoritative ICO registry underpinning entity resolution for the whole banking/payments actor watchlist.
A single CNB contract record - a parser example and evidence item, not a standalone monitored source.
Ceske drahy buyer profile: largest state buyer of ticketing and payment acceptance, publishes notices and awards continuously.
Sprava zeleznic E-ZAK instance is a live sectoral buyer profile with recurring payment/ticketing-adjacent tenders.
Prague Airport buyer profile - heavy payment-acceptance and treasury buyer; track both new Tender Arena and legacy E-ZAK.
Hlidac statu aggregates VVZ, buyer profiles and the contract register per ICO with an open API - highest-leverage monitored source.
VZP is the dominant health insurer and a major buyer of collection/payment services; procurement page is a durable entry point.
Second-largest health insurer with an active buyer profile covering IT and payment-collection procurement.
OZP buyer profile on e-zakazky.cz; mid-size insurer buying collection/payment and IT services.
CEZ supplier/tender portal is a recurring sectoral-entity source where treasury and customer-payment services are sourced.
DPP contactless fare-payment programme page documents a benchmark acquiring deal; evidence rather than a tender feed.
Single regional EOC tender article; representative of the municipal-operator pattern but URL check failed, recheck liveness.
Official commercial gazette with searchable corporate notices; useful low-frequency context on who the contracting entity is.
Static KB supplier general terms PDF - valuable bid-mechanics evidence, versioned rarely.
CSOB supplier-relations policy PDF sets vendor-selection governance at the largest CZ bank; a document, not a feed.
CSOB ethics code is part of the vendor onboarding pack; supporting document with limited standalone signal.
Erste Group Procurement is the actual routing hub for Ceska sporitelna external spend, with supplier docs and country-specific packs.
